topics.name: Tracing Basics
notes: - Trace 记录一次请求中所有步骤（模型调用、工具调用、检索等）的输入、输出、耗时和 token 用量。
- 一个 trace 由多个 run 组成，呈树形结构：父 run 包含子 run。
- LangChain / LangGraph 通过环境变量开启，不需要修改业务代码：
- 非 LangChain 代码可以用 @traceable 装饰器记录函数调用。
- API Key 属于机密信息，不要提交到代码仓库，也不要写进手机或前端客户端。

topics.name: Run Metadata
topics.description: Tags and metadata for filtering traces.
notes: - tags：简单字符串标记，用于筛选，例如 prod、experiment-a。
- metadata：键值对，例如提示词版本、模型版本、用户分组。
- 用 run_name 给 run 起可读的名称，方便在界面里查找。
- 不要在 metadata 里放敏感个人信息。

questions.title: What does a LangSmith trace record?

options.text: The tree of steps in a run, with inputs, outputs, latency and token usage
Only the final answer text
The model weights
The source code of the application

questions.explanation: Traces show each model call, tool call and retrieval, so you can see where time, tokens and errors come from.

questions.title: Fill in the decorator that traces a plain Python function.

options.text: traceable
tracer
trace_it
observe

questions.explanation: @traceable records each call of the function as a run, which is useful for code outside LangChain.

questions.title: Which environment variable setting turns on tracing for LangChain and LangGraph code?

options.text: LANGSMITH_TRACING=true
LANGSMITH_DEBUG=true
LANGSMITH_VERBOSE=true
LANGSMITH_LOG_LEVEL=trace

questions.explanation: Together with LANGSMITH_API_KEY this enables tracing without code changes. Older docs use LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 for the same purpose.

questions.title: Which details can you inspect in a trace of an agent run?

options.text: The prompts sent to the model
The tool calls and their arguments
Latency and token usage per step
The provider's private model weights

questions.explanation: Traces expose your application's behavior, not the internals of the model provider.

questions.title: What is the difference between tags and metadata on a run?

options.text: Tags are simple labels for filtering; metadata holds key-value details such as prompt_version
Tags change model output; metadata does not
Metadata is public; tags are private
They are identical

questions.explanation: Neither affects the model. Both help you find and group traces later.

questions.title: What does the config argument do in this call?

options.text: It attaches a tag and metadata to the run so it can be filtered in LangSmith
It changes the prompt to version v3
It deploys the chain to production
It limits the model to prod data

questions.explanation: The values are only annotations on the trace. They help you compare prompt versions or environments.

questions.title: How should the LangSmith API key be handled?

options.text: Keep it in an environment variable or secret store on the backend
Hard-code it in the source and commit it
Ship it inside the mobile app
Put it in trace metadata

questions.explanation: API keys are secrets. Anything shipped to a client or committed to a repository can be extracted.
